prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept. Transform the supplied CURRENT GAME forest screenshot into an original art-director review concept for a new standalone team PvP bamboo arena in Vo Lam Hero Defense. Image 1 is the actual forest environment and chibi scale reference; Image 2 is actual Hong Moc arena, the authoritative camera and visual-finish reference. Keep the SAME detailed crisp 2D raster wuxia game-art language, elevated top-down THREE-QUARTER ORTHOGRAPHIC camera, horizontal axis-aligned ground, no isometric diamond, no perspective vanishing point. Wide landscape 16:9 frame. Remove all text, labels, UI, characters, combat, shrine and existing screenshot overlays; author a clean environment plate. Large broad playable clearing occupying central 70 percent, worn ochre earth and irregular pale stone fragments matching actual forest material; enough unobstructed combat space for eight tiny chibi actors, not a narrow path. Two opposite broad entrances left and right, natural bamboo perimeter with jade and golden bamboo clumps, dark-green foliage, moss rocks, a few stone lanterns. Highly detailed but disciplined perimeter foliage like current forest; soft warm daylight, leaves and modest bamboo shadows, no gigantic blossoms or new architecture dominating the arena. Small discreet dart apertures in perimeter rock or bamboo fixtures, NO warning zones, NO projectiles frozen into the floor. Team spawn positions implied by empty space, no circles or markings. Playable plane flat and continuous, canopy limited to perimeter. Pixel-conscious clean edges and coherent small texture detail, no blur, no giant coarse pixel blocks, no photorealism, no glossy 3D. Full-bleed, no title or border. This is an unapproved static environment concept, not a runtime map or sprite atlas.

Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept. Create an original standalone PvP arena environment concept for Vo Lam Hero Defense by re-theming the game scene references. Reference 1 actual Hong Moc gameplay locks camera, proportions and crisp detailed raster wuxia art; Reference 2 hell concept supplies basalt/lava palette ONLY, do NOT copy its isometric layout, armies or gigantic structures. Landscape full-bleed 16:9. Flat 2D elevated TOP-DOWN three-quarter ORTHOGRAPHIC overworld game camera, horizontal ground planes; no vanishing point or isometric diamond. A single broad low mountain summit, an irregular rounded basalt plateau occupying about 75 percent of the image with ample contiguous unobstructed floor for 4v4 chibi combat. Surround it on all sides with a clearly legible orange-red lava basin, dark volcanic rock at the extreme perimeter. Main ground grey-charcoal rather than glowing red, intentional small basalt texture, hairline cracks concentrated in the outer bands, cool grey center so tiny players and spell VFX read clearly. Low broken ledges and layered cliff face visible only along lower edge, short and game-sized. A few chain anchors, broken dark stone pillars and tiny ember vents at far perimeter only. Depict the INITIAL full-size safe summit; outer rock bands suggest that the arena can gradually turn into lava. Lava area visually reads as traversable dangerous ground from which a player can move back onto rock: no sheer bottomless void, no impassable full-height wall around arena. Match current game environment detail and logical material scale, crisp authored edges, restrained pixel clusters, no blur, no 3D rendering. No people, NPC, monsters, HUD, UI, text, symbols for spawn, warning circles or title. Environment art concept only, not validated runtime geometry.

Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept. Reinterpret the supplied actual Hong Moc arena screenshot into an original XIANGYANG CITADEL / THANH TUONG DUONG standalone 4v4 PvP map review concept for the SAME Vo Lam Hero Defense game. Lock to current game's detailed crisp raster 2D wuxia environment look, overhead THREE-QUARTER ORTHOGRAPHIC camera with horizontal axis-aligned ground; no isometric diamond, no side view, no photorealistic or 3D render. Full-bleed landscape 16:9. Remove all existing UI/text/characters. A broad rectangular grey stone martial courtyard occupying the central 70 percent, enough open continuous playing space for eight small chibi actors; worn pale ash-grey flagstones with varied subtle cracks, a few scorch marks at outer edges only. North boundary: modest Song-era fortress gate facade with charcoal-blue tile roof, heavy dark timber double gate, crenellated grey fortress walls and two small watch towers. East/west perimeter low stone battlements, sparse red military banners, drums and braziers. South boundary low wall with central broad steps down, foreground wall cut low so no obstruction. A couple of arrow slits and fire-arrow equipment on the FAR perimeter towers imply random incoming flaming arrows, but NO visible soldiers, crowds, projectiles, explosions, warning zones or characters. No statue in the combat center, no props blocking the floor. Keep red lacquer, bronze/gold fittings, dark tiled roofing and precise stone/wood material density compatible with the actual Hong Moc reference. Wuxia military citadel, not imperial golden palace, not Japanese castle, not European fortress. Daylight, slight warm torchlight only near edges, crisp clean small-scale texture, no blur. No titles, no labels, no HUD, no decorative frame. Unapproved environment concept only, not runtime tilemap.

Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept. Create an original KIEM HO / SWORD LAKE standalone team PvP environment concept for the exact SAME Vo Lam Hero Defense game from these current game screenshot style references. Reference 1 locks Hong Moc material detail/camera; Reference 2 locks the current forest's terrain granularity and chibi world scale. Full-bleed wide landscape 16:9 clean environment, NO characters or UI. Consistent elevated top-down THREE-QUARTER ORTHOGRAPHIC 2D game camera, flat horizontal axis-aligned floor. Absolutely no horizon, sky, distant landscape, vanishing point, isometric diamond or 3D rendering. Broad irregular oval stone island filling central 70 percent, eight small actors can fight freely. Large unobstructed aged pale cool-grey flagstone floor, restrained weathering and moss at edges. A small modest circular FLUSH stone medallion at exact center reserves the standing position for an immortal swordsman later; no throne, no giant statue or central building. Jade-teal lake surrounds the island, shallow ripples and small lotus clusters at outer edges; low rock shores, a few weathered swords planted in shoreline rocks. Two broad opposing stone bridges enter from left and right. Small willow and bamboo groups on perimeter banks, one discreet roofed stone lantern pavilion at upper edge, matching current wuxia dark tile roof language. Strong yet quiet light jade/grey/charcoal palette, daylight, small pale gold highlights; preserve combat readability, no fog blanket or magical auras. Every environmental prop obeys the SAME top-down RPG camera. Crisp authored raster game-art detail, no oversized coarse pixels, no blurry painterly canvas, no photorealism. No title, labels, warning zones, attack VFX, HUD, NPC or people. This is a static review concept, not runtime art or collision data.

Use case: stylized-concept / identity design. Make ONE original full-body master still of DOC CO CAU BAI, immortal elderly wuxia swordsman NPC for Vo Lam Hero Defense, closely matching the actual game's small chibi actors. Reference 1 is the supplied Vo Dang style sheet for compact expressive chibi proportions ONLY; do not copy its young protagonist identity. Reference 2 is the current live Hong Moc scene to lock gameplay body silhouette, 2D raster finish and overhead camera. SINGLE character only, no sheet, no portrait inset, no text. Elevated top-down three-quarter FRONT-DOWN view, with head and front of robe visible; planted feet and a small contact shadow. Short compact adult chibi build with slightly oversized head, dignified weathered face, grey-white eyebrows, small neat grey beard, long silver-grey hair loosely tied high with dark ribbon. Plain weathered layered charcoal and muted slate-grey swordsman's robes, light grey inner collar, brown sash, simple black boots. No ornate royal crown, no shining armor, no long wizard hat, no giant shoulderpads. Quiet self-possessed swordsman; one hand rests on the hilt of a distinctive broad plain dark-iron straight sword with blunt heavy silhouette, tip resting beside him on ground, other hand relaxed behind his back. Enough negative space around sword/robe and feet. Restrained dark-grey/ivory/slate with small subdued bronze fastening, pale silver blade edge; no magical aura or huge slash in this master. Crisp hand-finished pixel-conscious 2D game art, coherent color clusters, clean defined edges, no blur, no photorealism, no anime splash painting, no 3D. Transparent background with real alpha, no checkerboard printed, no landscape, no floor platform. This is an UNAPPROVED design master, not final runtime sprite/animation; keep scale/proportions compatible with roughly 44px body inside current 80px gameplay canvas at later production.

Use case: stylized-concept. Produce an original ART-DIRECTOR REVIEW BOARD of hazard artwork for the same Vo Lam Hero Defense 2D wuxia game. Ref1 Vo Dang sheet supplies crisp pale sword qi/lightning pixel-art language, ref2 current live Hong Moc screenshot locks the elevated orthographic overhead camera, ref3 lava arena locks basalt/lava material. This is a CONCEPT BOARD, NOT an animation atlas. Landscape 16:9, eight clearly separated equally sized panels in a 4-column by 2-row layout, thin understated dark-gold dividers on charcoal. ONLY text is small panel numbers 1 to 8, no other words. All floor surfaces retain flat overhead three-quarter RPG camera, horizontal ground, no isometric diamond or perspective horizon. Panel 1: narrow steel throwing darts with short clean motion streak and tiny impact sparks, NO warning. Panel 2: small flaming arrow pointing diagonally downward with orange flame trail and a small floor impact, not a rocket, no area telegraph. Panel 3: close-up basalt floor edge cracking and becoming lava, still a low traversable seam, NO huge cliff or bottomless void. Panel 4: three small identical-top-down-view thumbnails of the same irregular basalt arena at broad/medium/small safe sizes, surrounding orange lava expands inward; no circle UI. Panel 5: faint pale-gold SEMICIRCLE warning covering exactly one half of a flat stone courtyard, straight diameter through center, floor beneath visible. Panel 6: matching released sword slash that sweeps that same HALF of ground, elegant silver-white broad arc and fine blade trails; do not turn it into a full circle. Panel 7: five separate small amber outlined circular ground lightning warnings on flat stone with clear safe space between. Panel 8: five pale-white/blue vertical lightning impacts at corresponding points, small ground sparks and visible gaps; no gigantic explosion. Restrained tidy pixel-conscious high-detail raster finish, same art-density as actual game, no blurry glow obscuring shapes, no 3D. No actors, no text explanations, no stats, no skill icons or new mechanics. Each panel reads as an authored game-art proposal, no screenshots pretending to be implemented.

Central window about 82 percent width and 77 percent height; world visible around all edges. Header exact 'LÔI ĐÀI', compact map label 'Hồng Mộc', occupancy '8/8'. Three EQUAL columns: left 'CHÍNH' with subtle jade-blue accent and '3/4', center 'KHÁN GIẢ' neutral charcoal with '2', right 'TÀ' subdued red accent and '3/4'. Left/right each four roster slots: 3 occupied and one empty; each occupied row has SMALL current-style chibi portrait, nickname, school/branch sublabel and ready check. No chat, no mode selector, no ranked badges, no potions, items or Defense statue HUD. On this pre-match screen do not display combat score or timer.
